question: How does the manifested universe appear within consciousness?
premises: The entire group of manifested beings appears in the self of consciousness.
One for whom it appears thus is the Lord of the universe.
inference: The universe shines as a reflection in consciousness, revealing the Lord of the universe.
plain_english: This entire manifested group of beings shines as a reflection in the self of consciousness; he for whom it shines thus is indeed the Lord of the universe.
